caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile, likely a cloth or shawl, that is predominantly dark red with some brownish and purple hues blended in the main body, and has two ornate, parallel borders along two adjacent edges. The borders feature intricate floral and circular patterns in shades of gold, yellow, red, and white, set against a light background. The borders are edged with long, gold-colored fringe. The textile is shown folded, with one corner overlapping the other, and both fringed edges visible. In the bottom left corner of the drawing, there is a small, detailed close-up of the border's decorative pattern, showing a red circle with an emblem or figures inside and a gold circle with stylized designs, both surrounded by floral elements. The entire composition is set within a neatly defined rectangular frame, and the artist’s name, Florence Truelson, appears below the drawing.
title: Tablecloth
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
